author: odkrywca_axioms
name: axiom_metabolic_retention_budget
desc: A color-context eligibility table is updated by endogenous energy change. Its trace retention varies with current reserve, while all context preferences are projected onto one global norm budget so memories compete for finite capacity.

author: odkrywca_dynamics
name: dynamics_metabolic_contrast
desc: Each organism maintains a slowly relaxing local metabolic reserve and a color eligibility trace. The deviation of current endogenous energy from that reserve changes the trace retention time, while the same local trace receives signed energy-change evidence and selects visual channels. No external reward or fixed age pulse is used.

author: odkrywca_dynamics
name: Energy-volatility-limited eligibility
desc: A local eligibility trace receives signed credit from changes in the organism's own energy. A low-pass estimate of absolute energy change shortens the trace lifetime during volatile periods and allows longer retention during stable periods, so old associations lose influence when recent consequences become unreliable.

author: odkrywca_axioms
name: Outcome-conditioned eligibility retention
desc: Eligibility traces for prior sensory choices decay more slowly when endogenous energy rises and more quickly when it falls; signed energy change continues to update the corresponding color preference. The trace therefore preserves causes of recovery and clears causes associated with depletion, while all states remain local and bounded.
